使用通配符时，一开始需要有一个“，”，因为它们只是在您写入提示窗口的任何内容之后添加，如果您结束

编辑：差点忘了，如果使用正确，保存图像节点会对图像进行排序。如果您单击节点上的黄色问号，您会得到一些相关信息。此外，您可以输入纯文本作为文件夹路径，特别有用的是“ckpt_name”和“sampler_name”

当我开始时，我希望我有这样的东西。好吧，我对此还很陌生，但我想我可能会分享它，以防其他新手感兴趣。

它实际上没什么作用，只是生成具有可选分辨率的图像

它包含 5 个部分：

图像生成 - 可选择的分辨率，还有“自定义”分辨率的选项。

高档 w.模型 - 使用升级模型升级 4 倍生成的任何内容，保存结果，第二次通过 KSampler，再次保存。 （我的 6900XT 几乎总是在结果如此高时使系统崩溃，所以我不能在这里过多谈论结果。）

通配符 - 如果您启用它并想要使用它们，则需要将其连接到 Prompt Positive。还不知道如何自动化这一点。

升级输入 - 升级加载图像节点上的图像并将其通过 KSampler 传递。对于添加细节或进行较小的编辑很有用。有 2 个额外的 Pass 来优化输出。相对高档比率可选，结果将始终可被 32 整除。保存每个通道。

升级输出 - 升级您生成的任何内容。与高档输入相同的选项

我想添加 Detailer 的东西，但还无法理解这些。另外我想让它更苗条。但无论如何，也许有人喜欢这个。

When i started out i wished i had something like this. Well, im still pretty new to this but i though i might share it in case some other newb is interrested.

It doesnt do much really, just image generation with Selectable resolutions

It comes with 5 sections:

Image Generation - Selectable Resolutions, Also has an Option for "custom" resolutions.

Upscale w. Model - Upscales whatever was generated by 4x using a Upscale Model, Saves the result, passes it trough KSampler a second time, saves it again. (My 6900XT almost always crashes the system on resultions that high so i cant say much about the results here.)

Wildcards - You need to connect it to Prompt Positive if you enable it and want to use them. Couldnt figure out how to automate this yet.

Upscale Input - Upscales the Image put on the Load Image node and passes it trough KSampler. Usefull to add details or make smaller edits. Has 2 additional Passes to refine the output. Relative Upscale ratio Selectable and Results will always be divisable by 32. Saves each pass.

Upscale Output - Upscales whatever you Generated. Same options as Upscale Input

I want to add Detailer thingys but could not wrap my head around those yet. Plus i want to make it slimmer. But whatever, maybe someone likes this.
